cliWarnings.name: Side-tab accent border
cliWarnings.description: Thick colored border on one side of a card — the most recognizable tell of AI-generated UIs. Use a subtler accent or remove it entirely.

cliWarnings.name: Gradient text
cliWarnings.description: Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text.

verdicts: side-tab: article blockquote accent, false positive as a card defect
gradient-text: unused utility, optional cleanup; no rendered design defect
limitations: T3 disconnected; persistent user-visible overlay state was not verified. Tokens and live-server output omitted.
